evidence.sql: WITH RECURSIVE method_split (method, rest) AS (SELECT Trim( SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.p, ',', 1) ), IF(LOCATE(',', s.p) > 0, SUBSTRING(s.p, LOCATE(',', s.p) + 1), NULL) FROM (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(?, '') AS CHAR (2000)) AS p) s UNION ALL SELECT Trim( SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.rest, ',', 1) ), IF(LOCATE(',', r.rest) > 0, SUBSTRING(r.rest, LOCATE(',', r.rest) + 1), NULL) FROM method_split r WHERE r.rest IS NOT NULL), currency_split (currency, rest) AS (SELECT Trim( SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.p, ',', 1) ), IF(LOCATE(',', s.p) > 0, SUBSTRING(s.p, LOCATE(',', s.p) + 1), NULL) FROM (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(?, '') AS CHAR (500)) AS p) s UNION ALL SELECT Trim( SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.rest, ',', 1) ), IF(LOCATE(',', r.rest) > 0, SUBSTRING(r.rest, LOCATE(',', r.rest) + 1), NULL) FROM currency_split r WHERE r.rest IS NOT NULL), req AS (SELECT DISTINCT method FROM method_split WHERE method <> ''), cur AS (SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM currency_split WHERE currency <> ''), ready_cap AS (SELECT cap.payment_method_code, cap.currency FROM t_channel_mid mid JOIN t_channel_account acc ON acc.channel_account_id = mid.channel_account_id AND acc.account_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN t_channel ch ON ch.channel_id = mid.channel_id AND ch.channel_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN t_mid_capability cap ON cap.mid_id = mid.mid_id AND cap.capability_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE mid.entity_no = ? AND mid.mid_status = 'ACTIVE' AND cap.mcc_code = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_mid_capability_detail d WHERE d.mid_capability_id = cap.mid_capability_id AND d.capability_code IN ('ACTION.PAY', 'ACTION.AUTHORIZE') AND d.boolean_value = 1)), summary AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req) AS requested_methods, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_channel_mid mid JOIN t_channel_account acc ON acc.channel_account_id = mid.channel_account_id AND acc.account_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN t_channel ch ON ch.channel_id = mid.channel_id AND ch.channel_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE mid.entity_no = ? AND mid.mid_status = 'ACTIVE') AS usable_mids, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(req.method ORDER BY req.method SEPARATOR ',') FROM req WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ready_cap rc WHERE rc.payment_method_code = req.method AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cur) = 0 OR rc.currency = '*' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cur WHERE cur.currency = rc.currency)))), '') AS missing_methods) SELECT IF(m.requested_methods > 0 AND m.missing_methods = '', 1, 0) AS satisfied, m.missing_methods AS out_missing_methods, CASE WHEN m.requested_methods = 0 THEN 'PAYMENT_METHODS_EMPTY' WHEN m.missing_methods = '' THEN NULL WHEN m.usable_mids = 0 THEN 'MID_NOT_FOUND' ELSE 'PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_READY' END AS missing FROM summary m LIMIT 2
